examples.selection_scope: The supplied example set contains only the retained original worker 0's three cases. Both displayed edits come from Goal task 8. These are first eligible nonzero edits within that supplied set, not representative sampling of all 20 cases.

limitations: The 8 baseline wins are shared by every arm and are not Astra rescues. Rescue medians use only four successful failed-baseline cases per Astra arm; capped failures remain in the 20-case outcome denominator and have no imputed tokens-to-success.

The single HTTP 503 has no reported usage. Canonical tokens and canonical-plus-interruption tokens are known lower bounds, not complete billed totals. Interrupted outstanding or unsynced calls can add unknown cost.
Reasoning tokens are included within output tokens and are not added again. No dollar rate is supplied.
Shared baseline, initialization and image gate are counted once in physical totals. Standalone per-arm costs repeat common setup and must not be summed as physical work.

Existing complete archive audit receipts and their byte hashes were checked; complete archives, all recorded arrays, hidden model states, dynamics and task outcomes were not independently rerun in this reconciliation.

Accepted decisions can be explicit or pixel no-ops. The 25 fallback actions and per-winning-rollout pixel changes are retained; successful rollouts do not establish that the pixel edits caused success.
method: Re-derived outcomes and costs directly from stored attempt records and physical provider rows with separate standard-library arithmetic; did not invoke the report builder or provider summarizer. Reconstructed only the four published example camera edits with the declared float64 RGB formula.
scope: Independent arithmetic and source-hash reconciliation of published results, all eight existing audit receipts, all 20 hash-bound source summaries, all canonical provider sidecars, interrupted saved ledger prefixes, CSVs and displayed RGB examples. This is not a new full-array or simulator audit.
